methodology: One independent whole-batch factual web review of all 40 frozen REVIEW_ITEMS under main CONTENT_LOOP revision 17b97a2 and applicable rubric A/C/D/F; 38 proposed shared concepts and 2 existing holds were judged once, without authoring replacements.

All 40 dexonline JSON responses were freshly downloaded serially, with at least 2.1 seconds after each response and redirects followed. Exact NFC accented lexical heads, selected DEX ’09/DOOM 3 IDs, homograph indices, register and complete noncolliding paradigms were checked; stress marks, superscript indices and the DOOM3 leading editorial exclamation mark were excluded from lexical head comparison.

Fresh direct reads obtained 54 unique corroborating Romanian pages/PDFs; the two Leroy Merlin pages refused direct requests with 403 and were independently read through the web tool, including their gardening guidance. Author cached JSON and receipts were left untouched. The initial HTML text-converter dependency was unavailable; already downloaded pages were then extracted with the standard library, without refetching or installing anything.

All 164 frozen edge captions, relation types and orientations plus 38 descriptions were compared with live DEX/botany, Romsilva, school, postal, horticultural and philatelic evidence. Species examples were kept qualified, cereal grains were treated as containing seeds, and treatment, dosage, numerical forestry and postal-policy claims were excluded from installed content.

Bundled normalization_map was independently applied to 206 distinct proposed label/alias keys against normalized_index, all KG labels/aliases, discovery-world labels and snapshots, current deferred terms and reviewed-unresolved keys. No foreign owner or duplicate normalized key is installed; Piersic fruit-owned plural forms stay held and the nine Cald-only proxies remain potential real-node upgrades.

Aggregate incoming/outgoing distinct neighbors were checked for all 38 proposed nodes: 4–6 total, at least 2 existing and 2 same-category, and at most 2 batch neighbors. This establishes lexical and factual correctness for shared guesses/neighbors only, not new curated rounds, Cald hidden-target eligibility or on-demand game selection; independent quality review and all prescribed install gates remain necessary.
